spec_defects.description: Published OpenAPI path keys use <parameter> placeholders, while declared in:path parameters and examples require substituting actual company shortnames, IDs and dates. OpenAPI requires {parameter} syntax. The pinned contract cannot match any of the 24 implemented operations. Provider auth examples and the PHP tutorial confirm variable substitution. A diagnostic copy changing only angle-bracket path delimiters (and dropping two unimplemented regex crew-detail paths) passes 24/24 request and response checks; it is supplemental, not the pinned conformance verdict.
